known_limitations: The native SkiaSharp runtime is not available in this environment (ARRTAGS_SKIA_COMPAT=1 fails to load libSkiaSharp), so the committed golden pixel/byte comparison (RenderGoldenTests, RenderDeterminismTests) could not be executed here; those cases are skipped by the default `./build.sh test` run (63 skips, unchanged from the attempt-1 baseline). The default-configuration V1 output is byte-preserved by construction and by the pure layout tests. This is a construction argument, not an executed pixel comparison.

Position and size are encoded identity-neutrally in both fingerprints: the V1 default (BottomLeft, Medium) appends nothing, while any other value appends badgePosition/badgeSize. Precondition: a non-default position or size is configured. Consequence: the renderer configuration fingerprint and the output fingerprint change for that configuration, so affected artwork republishes; a default configuration keeps the V1 fingerprint.

The safe-area clamp in ComputeEffectiveScale bounds the effective scale so that the scaled outer inset (24 * scale per edge) cannot consume the whole poster: effectiveScale <= min(outputWidth, outputHeight) / 48. Precondition: a poster smaller than 48 * effectiveScale in its smaller dimension. Consequence: the scale is reduced (possibly below the policy minimum) so the safe area stays non-negative (exactly zero at the clamp boundary). The new theory directly exercises this branch with three posters where the clamp binds (Medium 3000x120, Large 1000x40, Small 1000x30); it is deliberately not a pill-height fit clamp: pills that cannot fit the safe area still follow the existing shorten/omit behavior (ADR-019 clause 5), so no previously-omitted pill starts rendering on a short poster.

Task 12.4 remains: RendererConfiguration.CurrentSchemaVersion is still 1 and RenderVersion.CurrentRendererVersion is still 2, and no committed golden was regenerated. The new anchor/size golden cases and the single coordinated version advance are deferred to task 12.4 per PLANS.md. Phase 12 is in progress, Gate 12 is not met, and the v1.1.0-phase12 tag does not exist.

Per-anchor behavior is asserted at the pure layout-geometry level (BadgeLayoutEngine with a delegate measure) and at the settings-page/config/fingerprint level; the end-to-end rendered-pixel per-anchor comparison is deferred to the task 12.4 golden regeneration because the native renderer is unavailable here.
